lines.text: John writes to the seven churches in Asia, with grace and peace from Jesus Christ, the firstborn from the dead.
John was on the island of Cyprus when a voice like a trumpet told him to write on a scroll.
John saw seven golden lampstands and One like the Son of Man holding seven stars in His left hand.
John fell at His feet like a dead man, and the Living One holds the keys of Death and Hades.
